hebrewText: יִכְר֣וּ עָ֭לָי/ו חַבָּרִ֑ים יֶ֝חֱצ֗וּ/הוּ בֵּ֣ין כְּֽנַעֲנִֽים

tokens.bdb: properly, to dig; figuratively, to plot; generally, to bore or open
above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: to cut or split in two; to halve
tokens.kjv: divide, [idiom] live out half, reach to the midst, participle
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to cut or split in two; to halve
tokens.enLiteralWord: to cut or split in two; to halve
tokens.explanation: to cut or split in two; to halve
tokens.explanationEn: to cut or split in two; to halve

tokens.bdb: between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or
tokens.kjv: among, asunder, at, between (-twixt...and), [phrase] from (the widest), [idiom] in, out of, whether (it be...or), within.
tokens.explanation: ben — entre, no meio de, no espaço que separa
